name: Cash App OG social card by cash.app
description: A 1200×630 share card on a pure black field, deliberately left-weighted: the only element in the left half is a rounded-square app icon with a bold dollar glyph anchored bottom-left. The right two-thirds stacks two overlapping phone mockups — a white balance-list screen behind and a solid neon-green payment screen in front whose giant white '$20' numeral is the focal point — while a gold-flecked debit card bleeds off the bottom-right corner for texture. Hierarchy comes almost entirely from extreme scale contrast (the hero numeral is roughly eight times the UI label size), a single saturated accent carrying all brand colour, and edge-cropped props that imply a larger product beyond the frame.
